recomputation.implementation: NumPy absolute error/RMSE/bias and SciPy Spearman correlation from panel_predictions; additive assay offset is median(observed_pIC50 - panel_mean_pIC50) on the 20 calibration rows only.

frozen_phase17_source_offset_diagnostic.status: descriptive_only; cannot replace the prespecified Phase20 calibration fit or declare the gate passed

decision_check.primary_transfer: passes the point criteria recorded in validation-results.json
decision_check.failed_condition: absolute heldout calibrated bias magnitude is 0.2627401868, exceeding the 0.25 limit
decision_check.scientific_interpretation: Retrospective ranking is strong on this source panel, but the prespecified transfer/calibration qualification is not met. This result does not qualify unchanged Boltz predictions for novel screening.

split_and_shift_checks.caution: The test set is concentrated in one scaffold group of 27/30 compounds and has a substantially higher observed mean than calibration. Heldout metrics and the three-cluster bootstrap therefore have limited precision and may reflect source-series composition as well as transfer behavior.

bootstrap_limits.interpretation: These are descriptive scaffold-cluster resampling intervals conditional on the fitted offset. They exclude calibration-fitting uncertainty and pretrained-data uncertainty; the three heldout clusters make the interval especially unstable. The interval does not establish the absolute-bias gate and cannot convert a failed point gate into a pass.

limits: The source-offset diagnostic improves MAE and bias but was fixed from Phase17 and is not the prespecified Phase20 assay-calibration result.
All rows are retrospective known compounds; no prospective novelty or unseen-pretraining independence is established.
Biochemical ROCK2 ranking does not establish cellular efficacy, cryoprotective-agent activity, ice control, or post-thaw survival.
